acceptanceCriteria: Every docs/GLOSSARY.md citation into internal/mcp/bridge/bridge.go points at the intended statement and is pinned so line-citations-check fails when it drifts.
Other unpinned GLOSSARY.md line citations are inventoried and either pinned or retained as a listed limitation.
body: Found by the V1-0485 lane (2026-10-08, base f33ea8ef). docs/GLOSSARY.md cites bridge.go by bare line numbers without @hash anchors, so line-citations-check does not cover them; on origin/main several already land in the wrong function (e.g. :817 and :819 fall inside validTask). V1-0485 inserts 5 lines into bridge.go and shifts them further. Expected: glossary citations are pinned (path:line@8hex) or symbol-based and checked. Actual: unpinned and stale. Confirmed by the lane's code reading.
title: docs/GLOSSARY.md cites internal/mcp/bridge/bridge.go by unpinned line numbers that point at the wrong code
